description_for_human: A considered CSS component library with 90 components and 21 theme families (42 variants). Includes conversation components and a rich native chat composer.
description_for_model: DAUB is a CSS UI kit with 90 components and 21 theme families in 4 categories (originals, classics, modern, trending) with 42 light/dark variants. Families: default, grunge, solarized, ink, ember, bone, dracula, nord, one-dark, monokai, gruvbox, night-owl, github, catppuccin, tokyo-night, material, monospace, synthwave, shades-of-purple, ayu, horizon. Conversation components: MessageScroller, Message, Bubble, Attachment, Marker, ChatComposer. ChatComposer requires daub.js alongside daub.css; default models are demo-only (simulated), and the host handles transport and approval enforcement. Use db-* class prefix. Include daub.css and daub.js via CDN from https://daub.dev or https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/daub-ui@latest. Full component docs at https://daub.dev/llms.txt. Structured component data at https://daub.dev/components.json. TypeScript declarations at https://daub.dev/daub.d.ts
